title: What a Godly Man Does With His Debt (It's Not Hiding It)
caption:
A lot of godly men are one version of themselves at church and another one in their banking app. Debt is one of the quietest places a man stops being the same guy everywhere.

Open every statement. Tell someone the real number. Stop adding to it. Then pay it down one balance at a time, as an act of faithfulness, not punishment.

"The borrower is the slave of the lender." Proverbs 22:7

Save this for the night you finally open the app.

#faith #godlyman #debt #stewardship #christianmen
